nature: The piece's PRODUCTION scene — not a backfill. Built 2026-10-23 (JOB A, the Ep.1 v3 rebuild, under Hadi's exhaust-the-backlog order + the recreate-and-replace doctrine; Ep.2 v3 is the proven pattern) as one self-contained interactive HTML scene, and the delivered MP4 was rendered FROM it (CDP frame capture, JPEG q92, 2,512 frames; audio muxed from the WAV masters, single AAC encode). It is the delivered build's single source of truth: scene + 24 Decision Records + embedded audio in one file. Standalone-verified at build (the build report's H-01 test): copied alone into a fresh directory and opened from file:// — 229 words, 8 plate components, 10 labels, 0 external references, embedded audio ready, context panel showing the 24 Decision Records, 0 undecided.
